drivers: Houthi strikes on Saudi refineries and Ras Tanura terminal
Gulf of Mexico output shut in ahead of storm
Heavy oil glut in Americas due to freight squeeze
outlooks.summary: Supply risks from Middle East attacks, US Gulf storm shut-ins and refinery outages are offset by a heavy-oil glut in the Americas. Price is down 16% in 3 months and the supply-pressure score is weak (+0.09).
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether Ras Tanura and Rabigh outputs are restored and how fast US Gulf production restarts after the storm.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中东袭击、美国墨西哥湾风暴停产和炼厂故障带来供应风险,但美洲重质原油供应过剩予以抵消。价格三个月下跌16%,供应压力得分偏弱(+0.09)。
drivers_zh: 胡塞武装袭击沙特炼厂及拉斯塔努拉码头
风暴来临前美国墨西哥湾产量停产
运费飙升导致美洲重质油过剩
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注拉斯塔努拉和拉比格产能能否恢复,以及风暴过后美国墨西哥湾产量的恢复速度。

drivers: Fed rate hike fears and strong dollar
outlooks.summary: Headlines are all about macro-driven selling, not supply. There is no supply-shortage upside risk; the pressure is on price from the dollar, yields and ETF outflows.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the next Fed policy signals and ETF flow data.
outlooks.summary_zh: 新闻均为宏观因素驱动的抛售,与供应无关。不存在供应短缺带来的上行风险,价格受美元、收益率和ETF资金流出的压力。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息担忧与美元走强
触及14个月低点,ETF资金流出
无供应相关新闻
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美联储下一步政策信号及ETF资金流向数据。

drivers: Congo export quotas halve Glencore output
outlooks.summary: Congo quotas are cutting output and other export curbs are tightening feedstock. Price is down 24% in 3 months, so some of the dip may reverse if quotas keep biting.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Congo's quota adjustments and monthly export volumes.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果配额削减产量,其他出口限制也在收紧原料供应。价格三个月下跌24%,若配额持续generating约束,部分跌幅可能回补。
drivers_zh: 刚果配额使嘉能可钴产量减半
出口管制收紧电池金属供应
印度禁止黑粉出口
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果配额调整及月度出口量。

outlooks.summary: Weak copper output in Chile, a key by-product source, and smelter cuts point to tighter supply. But the headlines are mostly indirect, and price is already up 18% in 3 months and 42% in a year.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Chilean copper output data and Chinese export-control news.
outlooks.summary_zh: 智利铜产量疲弱(钼为铜的副产品)及冶炼厂减产指向供应收紧。但新闻多为间接影响,且价格三个月已涨18%、一年涨42%。
drivers_zh: 智利铜产量接近23年低点
亏损导致冶炼厂减产
中国出口政策动向
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注智利铜产量数据及中国出口管制消息。

drivers: Zimbabwe lithium export tax and local sourcing rules
outlooks.summary: Zimbabwe's tighter export rules and planned 2027 ban threaten supply, though miners are lobbying for delay. Price is down 13% in 3 months but up 71% in a year.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether Zimbabwe finalises the tax rule and delays or confirms the 2027 export ban.
outlooks.summary_zh: 津巴布韦收紧出口规则并计划2027年禁止出口,威胁供应,但矿商正游说推迟。价格三个月下跌13%,一年上涨71%。
drivers_zh: 津巴布韦锂出口税及本地采购规定
津巴布韦计划2027年出口禁令
印度禁止黑粉出口
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注津巴布韦是否敲定税收规则,以及是推迟还是确认2027年出口禁令。

drivers: Yttrium shortage and price surge in Japan
Laos dam breach halts rare earth operations
China expanded controls, but suspension extended to 2027
outlooks.summary: Yttrium is acutely short and Laos operations are suspended, but China's extension of the control suspension eases broad risk. Price is up 36% in a year, so part of the tightness is priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch yttrium availability and the restart of Laos operations.
outlooks.summary_zh: 钇严重短缺,老挝的稀土作业被暂停,但中国延长管制暂停期缓解了整体风险。价格一年上涨36%,部分紧张已被计入价格。
drivers_zh: 日本钇短缺且价格飙升
老挝溃坝导致稀土作业暂停
中国扩大管制,但暂停期延长至2027年
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注钇的供应情况及老挝作业的恢复。

drivers: Smelter cuts and weak Chile copper output
outlooks.summary: Congo conflict and Indonesian cuts keep supply tight. Price is up 56% in a year but flat over 3 months, so much is priced in; further upside needs new disruptions.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Indonesian export volumes and Myanmar mine access.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产使供应维持紧张。价格一年上涨56%但三个月基本持平,大部分已被计入;进一步上涨需要新的供应中断。
drivers_zh: 刚果冲突与印尼减产
缅甸污染与矿山问题
冶炼厂减产及智利铜产量疲弱
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注印尼出口量及缅甸矿区准入情况。

drivers: Major Chinese antimony mine halts production
China's US export ban suspension nears expiry
outlooks.summary: A major mine stoppage and the nearing expiry of China's export ban suspension point to tighter supply. Price is down 56% in a year, so there is room to rebound.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether China extends the export ban suspension and when the mine restarts.
outlooks.summary_zh: 主要矿山停产以及中国对美出口禁令暂停期临近到期,指向供应收紧。价格一年下跌56%,有反弹空间。
drivers_zh: 中国一座大型锑矿停产
中国对美出口禁令暂停期临近到期
美国寻求替代供应通道
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国是否延长出口禁令暂停期以及该矿山何时复产。

outlooks.summary: Export controls continue to constrain supply and ex-China alternatives will take time. Price is up 67% in 3 months, so much is priced in, but little new supply is near.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's licensing decisions and any ex-China project start-ups.
outlooks.summary_zh: 出口管制继续限制供应,中国以外的替代产能需要时间。价格三个月上涨67%,大部分已被计入,但短期内几乎没有新增供应。
drivers_zh: 出口管制持续generating影响
各国政府资助中国以外产能
康宁锗供应链风险
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国许可审批决定及中国以外项目的投产情况。

drivers: Gulf of Mexico shut-ins ahead of storm
Petcoke rally narrows discount to coal
outlooks.summary: Middle East and US Gulf disruptions support prices, but a heavy-oil glut in the Americas limits the squeeze. Price is up 15% already and the supply score is weak (+0.09).
outlooks.watch_next: Watch refinery restarts in Saudi Arabia and the US Gulf and the petcoke-to-coal spread.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中东和美国墨西哥湾的中断支撑价格,但美洲重质油过剩限制了供应紧张程度。价格已上涨15%,供应得分偏弱(+0.09)。
drivers_zh: 胡塞武装袭击沙特炼厂
风暴来临前墨西哥湾停产
石油焦上涨使其与煤炭的折价收窄
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注沙特和美国墨西哥湾炼厂复产情况以及石油焦与煤炭的价差。

outlooks.summary: Disruption risks are balanced by ample heavy oil in the Americas. The index is up 46% in a year but down 5% in 3 months, with a weak supply score (+0.09).
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Saudi refinery restarts and US Gulf recovery after the storm.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应中断风险被美洲充裕的重质油所抵消。该指数一年上涨46%,但三个月下跌5%,供应得分偏弱(+0.09)。
drivers_zh: 中东炼厂遭袭
美国墨西哥湾风暴停产
美洲重质油过剩
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注沙特炼厂复产及风暴后美国墨西哥湾的恢复情况。
